planets.name: TOI-762 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-762 A with a 3.47-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-762 A b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-762 A. Its orbit and size follow Hartman et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
